title: NouSR level table
description: The numbers behind one character's ability levels and traces (DESIGN.md K15, K20). Generated by tools/gamedata/level-tables.mjs from the game's data tables and committed under data/levels/; never edited by hand. One file per (character, ability_version): <id>.json for the original kit, <id>_v1.json for the buffed kit. Numbers and ids only, no game text. Everything here is the game's own table row, not a derived rule: (1) An ability's levels live in 'skills': the game gives each skill id a row per level, and a level-up node may cover several skill ids (an enhanced Basic ATK, an Ultimate variant, the memosprite's several skills); all of them rise together. 'levels' is indexed by level - 1 and holds that row's ParamList, whose meaning is per skill (it is the same list the in-game text fills its #1[i] placeholders from). The game stores 15 rows for Skill/Ultimate/Talent/Elation, 10 for Basic ATK and for memosprite skills; the highest reachable level is tree_max_level plus the eidolon bonuses (Basic 6+1, Skill/Ultimate/Talent 10+2, memosprite 6+1), and every reachable level has a row. (2) 'eidolon_levels' lists the eidolons that add levels to this node and how many, from the eidolon table's SkillAddLevelList (the total bonus is the sum of the entries at or below the member's eidolon). (3) Traces: a 'major' trace is the game's PointType 3 and a 'minor' trace PointType 1. 'key' is the tree position, B1..B3 and S1..S10, from the node's anchor slot; the scan's ability_1..3 and stat_1..10 are believed to be the same order, but that mapping is unverified against a real scan file. 'requires' is the game's PrePoint list: the trace points that must be unlocked first. Minor traces carry the game's stat id (PropertyType) and value; percentages are fractions (0.053 = 5.3%), SpeedDelta is flat SPD.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor completion.

format.description: Identifies the file type, the way scenario files carry "nousr-scenario".

version.description: Version of this schema. Goes up only on a breaking change.

game_version.description: Game version the data was read at, e.g. "4.7". Regenerated when the game version changes.

game_data_commit.description: Full commit of DimbreathBot/TurnBasedGameData the tables were read from.

character.description: Game character id as a string, as in HSR-Scanner and the scenario format, e.g. "1415" for Cyrene.

ability_version.description: 0 = the original kit, 1 = the buffed (Nova Flare) kit. Same field as the scan's and the scenario's ability_version.

abilities.description: The levelable abilities this character has, by stable kind key. Absent kinds do not exist for the character (memo_* only on Remembrance characters, elation only on Elation characters). The Technique has one level and is not listed.

major_traces.description: The 3 major traces (PointType 3), B1 to B3.

minor_traces.description: The 10 minor traces (PointType 1), S1 to S10, each a flat stat bonus.

point.description: The trace-tree node that levels this ability (a PointID in the game's skill tree table).

tree_max_level.description: Highest level the tree reaches before eidolons: 6 for Basic ATK and memosprite abilities, 10 for the rest.

eidolon_levels.description: Eidolons that add levels to this ability and how many each adds. Empty when none does.

skills.description: By the game's skill id, every skill this level-up node raises.

levels.description: ParamList per level, index 0 = level 1. Always has at least tree_max_level plus the largest eidolon bonus rows.

key.description: Tree position: B1..B3 for major traces, S1..S10 for minor traces.

point.description: The trace's PointID in the game's skill tree table (the id Fribbels' trace tree uses, as a string).

requires.description: PointIDs that must be unlocked before this one (the game's PrePoint). Empty when the trace is available from the start.

key.description: Tree position: B1..B3 for major traces, S1..S10 for minor traces.

point.description: The trace's PointID in the game's skill tree table (the id Fribbels' trace tree uses, as a string).

requires.description: PointIDs that must be unlocked before this one (the game's PrePoint). Empty when the trace is available from the start.

stat.description: The game's stat id (PropertyType), e.g. CriticalDamageBase, SpeedDelta, HPAddedRatio, StatusProbabilityBase.

value.description: The stat bonus. Percent stats are fractions (0.053 = 5.3%); SpeedDelta is flat SPD.
